title: PathQ-Former: query-based multimodal fusion of whole-slide images and pathway tokens for missing-modality-robust cancer survival prediction
description: Code, configurations, archived per-run results (180 five-fold runs on five TCGA cohorts) and the experimental report for PathQ-Former, a Q-Former-style fusion model of whole-slide-image patch embeddings (UNI2-h) and RNA-seq pathway tokens that predicts discrete-time survival hazards and keeps working when either modality is missing. Under an identical fixed-budget protocol it improves the C-index over the official SurvPath implementation by +0.037 pooled over 75 paired folds (paired t p = 0.002). Trained checkpoints are on the HuggingFace Hub (sharoonsharif1/PathQFormer-checkpoints).
